capabilities: Preview .html and .htm files in a sandboxed iframe
Edit text, link addresses and image attributes from sidebar forms
Save only the changed source ranges
Back up drafts and merge disk conflicts
List backlinks, outgoing links and referenced assets
disambiguation: Not an HTML snippet or theme editor; it opens and edits standalone .html files stored in the vault.
extras: Desktop only; mobile is not supported. Drafts are stored per device under the plugin folder and are deleted if the plugin is uninstalled. Some UI text (command-palette names, embed buttons, errors, default save-as suffix) remains Chinese-only.
problem: HTML files in a vault cannot be opened as notes, previewed, or edited in place inside Obsidian.
summary: Previews .html files in Obsidian and edits selected text, links and images through a sidebar, saving only the changed source ranges.
